data.Name: Storm Warning
data.Description: An old mystic warns of unnatural storms — investigate their source
data.Template_Text: [NPC1], a weathered mystic, grabs your arm with surprising strength. "The storms aren't natural," they hiss. "Something at [Location1] is calling them forth." Dark clouds churn overhead as you approach, and [Enemy1] emerges from the tempest to bar your path...
data.Chain_Config: {"on_success":{"mode":"auto_activate","quest_card_id":"quest_chain_storm_source","inherit_placeholders":["NPC1"],"message":"The wind howls louder — destroying the sentinel only revealed the true storm caller!","set_transition":"transition_cursed_land"},"on_failure":{"mode":"none"}}
data.2nd_state_Template_Text: You cut through [Enemy1] near [Location1], but the storms only intensify. [NPC1] points skyward with trembling hands — a far more powerful figure commands the tempest from deeper within the cursed land.
